# Arvin Roeslim

> Mobile developer in Jakarta. Builds mobile apps with Flutter, Kotlin and Swift, and designs them in Figma first. Final-year Mobile Application & Technology student at BINUS University (2023 to now), open to full-time mobile developer roles.

## Selected projects

- evo+, 2026, thesis team project, coming soon: money tracker for young Indonesians. Arvin's part: product concept, UI/UX design, the Evo mascot, Flutter front end (MVC), server setup.
- Waste2Cash, 2025, campus team project (Kotlin): admin dashboard for collectors.
- LaundryHub, 2025, campus team project (Kotlin): led the Figma design, built queue and booking.
- DoJo Movie, 2025, campus team project (Kotlin): Home page, Maps integration, SQLite caching.
- Video Tape Store, 2024, campus team project (Flutter, Node.js): store UI and admin dashboard.
- Christian Wijaya, 2025, solo campus project: fashion brand website, design and build.
